clips.title: The story
paras: Ashenvale's trails grow safer when Sharptalon's Claw is taken from the forest. Bring the trophy to Senani Thunderheart at Splintertree Post to prove Sharptalon has fallen and protect Horde supply lines.

Sharptalon hunts the paths to Splintertree Post as the Horde seeks resources in Ashenvale. The aggressive hippogryph strikes peons and couriers traveling between forward logging camps and the outpost. Its attacks hinder Horde work in the region, where night elven sentinels and dangerous wildlife both threaten the newcomers.

Senani Thunderheart, a tauren huntress, directs Horde hunters against Ashenvale's deadliest predators. Sharptalon's talon proves the hippogryph has fallen. Bring the trophy to Splintertree Post, where the outpost's defenders honor the hunt and frightened laborers can walk the woods with less fear.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The mighty hippogryph Sharptalon has been slain, with the claw of the felled beast serving as a testament to your victory. Senani Thunderheart at the Splintertree Post will no doubt be interested in seeing this trophy as proof of your deeds.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Yes, mighty adventurer, I sensed your arrival. I trust you have more news to report to me about your hunt?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Most impressive, friend... The claw of Sharptalon could not have been easy to get! The Ashenvale Hunt goes well for you!

Sharptalon had long terrorized the peons from the lumber camps near its path as they tried to travel here to Splintertree Post. No doubt once the word gets out that it was you who put down the beast, many rousing songs of your bravery will be heard at campfires and lumber mills across Ashenvale!
